page.layout: One page of running text in a single column. No marginal notes. At the head: the running title "AVGVSTINVS" with "Cap.96." at the left. Below the text, at the right: the catchword "per-".

main_text.p: rat. Atque in fide Christi a monachis qui phrő-tisteria & asceteria sua in Arabicis desertis habebant, instituti, permanserunt in ea, donec variis & pene infinitis novarum subinde haere-sèon tempestatibus & fluctibus agitata & submersa vera fidei doctrina, tandem in Ægypto, Arabia, & Syria extincta est: imprimis autem, ut diximus, erroribus Eutychianorum, qui omne Orientem & Meridiem, praesertim vero Ægyptum & Arabiam, mire vexarunt & tandem prorsus subuerterunt. Mahumet igitur Arabs & Ismaelita, homo ambitiosus, astutus, ἀλλαξω[?], & ad mundi totius perniciem natus, religionis Christianae difsidia pertæsus, Sergio monacho Nestoriano (qui tum exul in Arabia versabatur) adiutore, & Ioanne Antiocheno Ariano, itemq; Iudæo quodam Selan astrologo, & Bar-ra Persa Iacobita suggestore, nouum prorsus dogma & inauditae antea blasphemiae plenum commentus est, quod Eubolara[?], Aomar, Odmen, & Hali Saracenis & Arabibus patrocinatibus & commendantibus a Saracenis ipsius Mahumeti popularibus primum solis: post autem ab Arabibus universis qui Mahumetum etiam expulerant, receptum est. Hinc magna huic doctrinae laus accessit, quæ statim ab Ægyptiis vicinis populis recepta, & propter iam tadiu incertam apud se fidei Christianae doctrinam probata est. Deinde vi armorum ab ipso Mahumeto, qui exercitum collegerat suaque dogmata armis tuebatur, late propagata est. page.notes: Top-left running head reads "Cap.96." followed by the title; the title is set in spaced capitals and normalised to AUGUSTINUS per the u/v rule. Greek word after "astutus," is hard to read and is uncertain: transcribed as ἀλλαξω[?]. "Eubolara" and "Hali" are uncertain (Eubolara marked). The final word "fu-" is hyphenated across the line break; the catchword "per-" belongs to the next page. The paragraph is treated as continuous, as no indented line starts a new paragraph on this page. Show-through from the reverse side is not transcribed.
